senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כָּרָה)to hire, engage; to rent.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:1">B. Mets. VI, 1</cite> <he>השׂוֹכֵר את וכ׳</he> if one engages artisans (through an agent).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:2">Ib. VIII, 2</cite> <he>שאלה … ושְׂכָרָהּ וכ׳</he> if he borrowed the cow for half a day, and hired her for half a day.
Tosef. ib. IX, 1, sq. השׂוֹכֵר שדה if one rents a field; a. v. fr.—שׂוֹכֵר hirer, employer; tenant.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 103a:2">B. Mets. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ מהימן בשבועה</he> the employer is believed on his oath (that he has paid the wages).

Ib. 102ᵇ כוליה לש׳ the whole (rent for the thirteenth month of the leap year) goes to the tenant, i.e. he need not pay extra rent for the intercalated month; a. v. fr.—Esp. שוכר tenant of land for rent payable in money, contrad. to חכיר.
Tosef. Dem. VI, 2 ש׳ במעות וכ׳ the sokher pays the rent in cash, the ḥakkir (or ḥokher) in kind; a. fr.—Part. pass. שָׂכוּר; f. שְׂכוּרָה.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:2">B. Mets. VIII, 2</cite> if the hirer says, <he>ש׳ מתה</he> it is the hired cow that died; <he>ביום שהיתה ש׳ מתה</he> she died on the day when I used her for hire; <he>בשעה … ש׳ וכ׳</he> she died at that time of the day when I used her for hire; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 110a:4">B. Bath. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם יַשְׂכִּיר אדם את עצמו וכ׳</he> a man should hire himself out for &c., v. <cite ref="P00033"><he>עֲבוֹרָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:7">B. Mets. VIII, 7</cite> <he>המַשְׂכִּיר … המשכיר וכ׳</he> if one lets a house …, the landlord has to furnish &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>ה׳ לו להדשים … למשכיר</he> if he let the house by the month, … the landlord has the benefit of the intercalated month, v. <cite ref="P00059"><he>עָבַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 4a:9">Pes. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>על המ׳ לבדוק</he> the landlord is obliged to search the house for leavened matter; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (denom. of שָׂכָר) to cause to profit, to benefit. Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Vayesheb 13 צריך … משכיר אותו (not משביר) a man must pray for the welfare of him that benefits him.
(denom. of שָׂכָר) to be rewarded, benefited; to have the advantage.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 92b:4">Yeb. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>אם כן מצינו חוטא נִשְׂכָּר</he> if this be the law, then he that sinned would be at an advantage; <cite ref="Ketubot 11a">Keth. 11ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שלא יהא חוטא נ׳</he> it is done in order that the sinner should not be at an advantage.
<cite ref="Pesachim 50b:10">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 4:8">Tosef. Yeb. IV, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00703"><he>זָרִיז</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to profit; to deal in. Tanḥ. l. c. לפי … מִשְׂתַּכֵּר מצאנו וכ׳ because Jacob was benefited by his flock &c.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Pesik. R. s. 40</cite> <he>ונִשְׂתַּכַּרְתִּי</he>, v. <cite ref="N01108"><he>נָצַח</he></cite>. Pes. l. c. <he>המשתכר בקנים וכ׳</he> he that deals in reeds and vessels. Ib. 54ᵇ <he>ואין אדם יודע במה משתכר</he> and no man knows which of his enterprises will turn out profitable; Mekh. B’shall., Vayass‘a, s. 5.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 91a:2">B. Bath. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מִשְׂתַּכְּרִין בא״י וכ׳</he> in Palestine you must not be a dealer in provisions, as wine &c. (serve as middleman between producer and consumer); <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:1">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:1">V</cite>), 1; a. fr.
